title: Ashbury Rewards Award Terms: Points Returned after a Cancellation or No-Show
content:
Points deducted for an Ashbury Rewards Reward Night Rate reservation come back after a cancellation or a no-show. The terms below set how many.

## Terms

1. **Reservation concerned.** The award reservation concerned is the member's Reward Night Rate reservation attached to the membership whose status is cancelled or, when there is none, whose status is no-show, as shown on the member's Room Reservations records.
2. **Points deducted.** The points the reservation deducted are the award redemption transactions naming it less any redeposit already naming it.
3. **Cancellation before the deadline.** On a cancellation recorded before the deadline the points the reservation deducted are returned in full.
4. **Cancellation after the deadline, or no-show.** On a cancellation recorded after the deadline, and on a no-show, the redeposit is the points the reservation deducted less the retained night charge, and it never exceeds the points it deducted.
5. **Points nights.** The points nights of the reservation are its nights less its certificate nights, and its charged points nights are the points nights less one free night for every 5 points nights when the member's tier has the fifth-night saving on points.
6. **Night value.** The night value is the points the reservation deducted divided by its charged points nights, rounded down to a whole point.
7. **Retained night charge.** The retained night charge is the night value multiplied by the retained share of the night value and divided by one hundred, rounded down to a whole point. The retained share is one hundred percent — the whole night value.

## Worked figures (hypothetical reservations, tier with the fifth-night saving)

| Item | Reservation A | Reservation B |
|---|---|---|
| Status and timing | Cancelled after the deadline | No-show |
| Nights, certificate nights | 3, 0 | 6, 0 |
| Points deducted (term 2) | 75000 | 125000 |
| Points nights, charged points nights (term 5) | 3, 3 | 6, 5 |
| Night value (term 6) | 25000 | 25000 |
| Retained night charge (term 7) | 25000 | 25000 |
| Redeposit (term 4) | 50000 | 100000 |

Had reservation A been cancelled before the deadline, all 75000 points would come back under term 3.
